scope: Independent source review of root new P04-17 Window/real-engine integration tests and only the three-target CMake delta

finding_history.initial_issue: Any terminal retained positive rate could trigger cancellation only after timeout, causing a false-positive cancellation assertion.
finding_history.correction: Require packet state Observed and Bridge busy before accepting positive payload rate and requesting cancellation.

checks: Synthetic tests exercise actual Window admission/cache, no Page collection, close/reopen immutable replay, saved refresh preservation, 600-point eviction and fresh operation/session reset.

Real single/multifile cases use the unchanged independently qualified 8-piece generated fixture, owned loopback-only seed/transfer, actual rate packets and completed payload/statistics identity checks.

Positive payload/protocol rate points are required from actual transfer, point times strictly increase and combined rate dominates payload; no expected-output mirror or graph-derived observations are used.
Close/reopen and saved refresh compare retained actual point values, while selected pane width/filter state remain independent.
Fresh completed-payload recheck requires increased operation ID and actual zero payload counter/rates, preventing inherited prior-transfer data.
Cancellation uses unchanged 7-of-8-piece partial seed incapable of completing; cancellation is now driven only by a busy Observed positive payload-rate packet.
Stack declaration order destroys Bridge and joins its owned worker before Window and generated fixture storage; all early QtTest return paths retain this ordering.
No elapsed sleeps or arbitrary GUI delays are introduced; qWaitFor/QTRY conditions wait on actual state and retain 30-second inner limits.
All three new test targets use AUTOMOC, strict warning errors, Qt6::Test and 120-second offscreen unit/statistics/activity policy. The real target links actual desktop host/local engine/libtorrent.
Every previous CMake byte is unchanged after removing this new three-target block; original fixture and old 12-row suite bytes match the qualified source map.
limitations: This review does not independently qualify our own History implementation or Oracle graph/Page code.
Generated fixtures and native graph integration do not establish Java Activity smoothing/global-history equality.
Root reports premature configure/build before graph test source existed; that is retained build history, with no compilation/runtime credit from this source review.
Actual test outcomes and timings remain root-owned pending qualification.
